demos.name: ReferenceOverview
demos.description: We encourage you to build you own component by reusing those demo helpers.

demos.name: ReferenceLineBasic
demos.description: When a chart has multiple axes, use the axisId prop to specify which axis the reference value belongs to.

demos.name: ReferenceLineLabel
demos.description: You can add a label prop to display text alongside the reference line.

demos.name: ReferenceLineStyled
demos.description: Using the labelStyle is necessary if you your label has multiple lines.

demos.name: ReferenceAreaBasic
demos.description: Notice the usage of composition to be able to put the reference area below the plots.

demos.name: ReferencePointBasic
demos.description: With the same logic as the previous section, you can highlight specific points in the chart.
